Es larga la espera. Pero la atención es muy buena. Eso opine hace dos años. Todas las semanas cargo en la YPF.
Hoy fui atendido por una chica nueva,apenas llegué me preguntó la forma de pago, le dije que por la App, ya tenía bajado del vehículo, me pidió que use el celular dentro del auto de mala manera, ya que no podía acceder a la aplicación, le pedí el Wifi "no funciona", de nuevo de mala manera, decidi no cargar e irme.

(Translated by Google)
The wait is long. But the service is very good. That's what I thought two years ago. I fill up at YPF every week.
Today I was served by a new girl. As soon as I arrived, she asked me how I wanted to pay. I told her I'd use the app, which I already had in my car. She rudely asked me to use my phone inside the car since I couldn't access the app. I asked for the Wi-Fi, and she said it wasn't working. Again, she was rude. I decided not to fill up and leave.
